summary: PO explicitly accepted all six criteria of six new ready responses and rejected only uncertainty in the two new blocked responses. All 48 criteria judged: 46 pass, two fail. Prior guard applicability and cross-source citation repairs approved in recorded snapshots. Additional identity-applicability questions are nonblocking for intent analysis; candidate not promoted.
